title: Seedance 3.0 Brings Feature-Length Control to AI Video Generation
key_facts: Seedance 3.0 is the latest release of the Seedance AI video generator line.
Single clips can now run to 30 seconds, up from 4 to 15 seconds in Seedance 2.0.
Reference material rises from 9 images, 3 videos and 3 audio files to 50 items: up to 30 images, 10 videos and 10 audio files.
It adds 3D spatial pre-visualisation and camera blocking for planning shots.
Aimed at creators, marketers and small teams making social and product video.
The article does not name the company behind Seedance or give a release date.
quote_evidence: Single generations now stretch to 30 seconds, up from the 4 to 15 second window of the previous version
Seedance 3.0 raises the ceiling to 50 materials total, split across as many as 30 images, 10 videos, and 10 audio files.
why_it_matters_hint: Longer clips and more reference material let a project keep the same character or product across shots.
notes: Specifications are the product's own claims; no independent test. Developer and release date not stated in the article.
